source: local game 1.5.3 GameAssembly.dll (BlackHoleTree.updateMutator native disassembly, capstone) + 1.5.3 bh2 node data

method.note: switch over internal node effect labels retrieved from ScriptString (script.json), e.g. "Black Hole Binary Star", "Black Hole One Hole Only", "Black Hole Convert To Fire", "Black Hole Ignite Chance Per Second", "Black Hole Additional Charge", "Black Hole Added Duration and Cooldown", "Black Hole Damage and Less Pull", "Black Hole Increased Damage", "Black Hole Increased Fire Damage", "Black Hole Added Fire Damage", "Black Hole Added Cold Damage", "Black Hole Extra Black Hole".

heat_wave.label: Black Hole Ignite Chance Per Second
heat_wave.behavior: accumulator += points * 2.0 (percent units; 2% per point), later turned into ignite-chance-per-second stat
heat_wave.matches: node tooltip +2%/point; alt text 100% fire res +1 point = 200%/s; code in BlackHoleMutator.Mutate multiplies by uncapped fire resistance and applies aura with interval 0.5s, applyOnStart=true

red_giant.label: Black Hole Convert To Fire
red_giant.behavior: sets conversion flags; duration accumulator += 0.8 (+80%); pull disabled

tidal_force.label: Black Hole Damage and Less Pull
tidal_force.behavior: adds Stats.Stat(property=Damage(0), tags=0, increased=0, more=points*0.15); pull strength accumulator -= points*0.15

endless_maw.label: Black Hole Added Duration and Cooldown
endless_maw.behavior: duration accumulator += points*0.3 (+30%/point); cooldown accumulator += points*2 (seconds)

binary_system.label: Black Hole Binary Star
binary_system.behavior: sets binary-star flag AND adds Stats.Stat(property=Damage(0), tags=0, increased=0, more=points*1.0) => +100% more damage (in addition to structural two-component cold->fire copy found in BlackHoleMutator.Mutate)
binary_system.open: whether structural copy (2 components, addBaseDamage is simple +=) stacks with +100% more for 4x body; whether the damage more stat is inherited by Ignite (user rule 5) making Ignite also 2x. v1 currently models structural only (extra_more=0) and does not grant Binary more to Ignite.

singularity.label: Black Hole One Hole Only
singularity.behavior: sets one-hole-per-cast flag AND adds Stats.Stat(property=Damage(0), tags=0, more=points*1.0) => +100% more

extra_black_hole.label: Black Hole Extra Black Hole
extra_black_hole.behavior: extra black-hole accumulator (Scattered/Armageddon family); runtime semantics (spawn extra hole per cast?) pending

open_items: Binary System: structural 2 components + separate +100% more stat; resolve stacking and Ignite inheritance before ruleset update
Recurrence (property 70 Cooldown Reduction) vs v1 ICR-pool assumption; cooldown/charge formula pending
